quote: A driver shall not stop or suddenly decrease the speed of a vehicle without first giving an appropriate signal to the driver of any vehicle immediately to the rear.

activation.condition: A driver stops or suddenly decreases vehicle speed with a driver immediately to the rear.

obligation.description: A driver shall not stop or suddenly decrease the speed of a vehicle without first giving an appropriate signal to the driver of any vehicle immediately to the rear.

timing.description: An appropriate signal must precede the stop or sudden decrease.
